idle_side.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing right.

idle_down.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

idle_up.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

walk_side.prompt: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways. It stays in place, facing right.

walk_down.prompt: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

walk_up.prompt: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

eat_side.prompt: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up. It stays in place, facing right.

eat_down.prompt: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

eat_up.prompt: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

tail_swing_side.prompt: Swings its heavy clubbed tail out to the side in a wide fast sweep, then brings it back behind it. Its body and feet stay still. It stays in place, facing right.

tail_swing_down.prompt: Swings its heavy clubbed tail out to the side in a wide fast sweep, then brings it back behind it. Its body and feet stay still. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

tail_swing_up.prompt: Swings its heavy clubbed tail out to the side in a wide fast sweep, then brings it back behind it. Its body and feet stay still. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

hurt_side.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing right.

hurt_down.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.

hurt_up.prompt: Flinches: jerks its head and body back, then returns to its stance. It stays in place with its back to the viewer the whole time.

death_down.prompt: Stumbles, its legs give way and it falls over onto its side, then lies still. It stays in place, facing the viewer the whole time.
